title: The Pathan Disguise Is Exposed Among the Brars

blocks.text: The Brars try to recover the initiative by returning in Pathan disguise, but the ruse falters once the Singhs see they cannot safely keep retreating into waterless ground. The Khalsa halts where it stands, yields the outcome to the Guru's will, and turns back under raised drums, standards, and shouted orders.

From the rear guard, Charat Singh recognizes the Brars beneath their Pathan disguise and calls the alarm. His warning sends the Singhs charging back so quickly that some Brars are seized on the spot while others break and run.

The page closes by widening the quarrel into a longer campaign of pressure on Brar villages. Mothers of captured sons come pleading after the Khalsa, livestock and tribute are taken from hostile households, and the Brars are gradually forced from open defiance into subordination.
